library.no_playlists_hint: No playlists yet. Save one from its page, or create one in your Library.
library.collab_tooltip: Others can add to this playlist
library.every_song_saved: Every song you’ve saved, in one list

library.no_library_songs: No songs in your library yet. Hit the ⋯ on a song and save it, or like it, and it lands here.
library.empty_signed_out: Nothing saved yet. Open a playlist or album and hit Save to library, or sign in for the one on your account.

local.no_folders: No folders yet. Add the one your music sits in and it shows up here.
local.nothing_playable: Nothing playable found in those folders yet. Looking for mp3, flac, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, wav, wma, aiff, ape, wv and mka files.

tabs.general_hint: History, integrations and how the app starts.

tabs.themes_hint: Colors, fonts and the player view.

general.autostart_hint: Automatically start Limusic when your system boots.
general.close_to_tray_hint: Keep Limusic running in the background when closing the window.
general.system_titlebar_hint: Let your desktop draw the window frame and its buttons. Limusic keeps its own toolbar below it.
general.discord_rpc_hint: Show the currently playing song on your Discord profile.
general.update_banner_hint: Show a banner when a new version of Limusic is available.
general.proxy_hint: Route all network requests through a custom proxy server.
general.stream_clients_hint: Turn a client off to skip it when resolving streams. Overridden by the {var} env var.

themes.font_placeholder: Font installed on this computer, e.g. Inter
themes.font_not_installed: Not installed — install the font, then reopen settings.
themes.tint_palette_hint: Only shades the default palette, {theme} brings its own colors.
themes.tint_hint: Shades the greys: surfaces, borders and secondary text.
themes.roundness_hint: Corner radius of cards, buttons and artwork.
themes.zoom_hint: Scales everything in the window. The zoom shortcuts change it too, and it is remembered between launches.
themes.load_font_file_hint: Load a .ttf, .otf or .woff from anywhere on this computer. It joins both dropdowns above.
themes.open_player: Open the player when you press play
themes.open_player_hint: On, playing a song, album or playlist brings up the full player view. Off, it starts playing and leaves you on the page you were browsing.
themes.tabbed_player: Queue and lyrics in the player view
themes.tabbed_player_hint: On, the player view carries them as tabs and the bar's two buttons switch between them. Off, those buttons only ever open the side panels, which stay open over the player view so you can see both at once.
themes.artwork_background_hint: Tint the player view with the playing track's cover, blurred. Off leaves it plain.
themes.artwork_accent_hint: Recolor the app from the playing track's cover: accent, surfaces and borders, fading between tracks. Off keeps the selected theme's own colors.
themes.reset_theme_hint: Drop the color, roundness and font overrides. Keeps the preset.
themes.app_icon_hint: A PNG replaces the icon in the tray, this window and Alt-Tab. Shortcuts, the file manager and the Windows taskbar button keep the installed one.

playback.normalize_volume_hint: Even out how loud tracks play, so a quiet master is not buried by the one after it. Turn it off to hear every track exactly as it was mastered.
playback.autoplay_hint: Continuously play recommended tracks when the queue finishes.
playback.crossfade_hint: Fade the end of each track into the start of the next one. Runs a second audio decoder while tracks overlap, so it uses a little more memory.
playback.crossfade_lt_paused: Paused while you are in a Listen Together room: an overlap of two tracks cannot be kept in sync with everyone else.
playback.crossfade_duration_hint: How long the overlap lasts. Short tracks fade for less, so a fade never starts before the one before it has finished.
playback.prevent_duplicates_hint: Avoid adding songs that are already in the current queue.
playback.sticky_shuffle_hint: Leave off and shuffle applies only to what's playing: opening an album or playlist afterwards plays it in order.
playback.play_history_hint: Remember recently played tracks for personalized recommendations.
playback.music_videos_hint: Show video stream when available instead of audio only.
playback.hide_videos_hint: Only show audio tracks and official releases in search results.
playback.blocked_artists_hint: Blocked artists are left out of radio, autoplay and recommendations. Playlists and albums you open still play everything in them.
playback.blocked_artists_empty: Nobody blocked yet. Use "Block artist" from a track's ⋯ menu.
playback.lastfm_primary_artist_hint: Send only the first credited artist to Last.fm, so your plays land on the real artist page. Names joined with "&" are kept whole.
playback.lastfm_primary_strict_hint: "Future & Metro Boomin" scrobbles as "Future". Duos with "&" in their name get shortened too.
playback.lyrics_provider_hint: Fetch community-synced lyrics for active songs.

hotkeys.title: Global Hotkeys
hotkeys.description: Control playback with customizable keyboard shortcuts even when Limusic is minimized or running in the background.
hotkeys.enable_hint: Global hotkeys are disabled. Turn them on to listen for shortcuts system-wide.
hotkeys.recording: Hold a modifier and press a key...
hotkeys.conflict: This shortcut is already assigned to "{action}"
hotkeys.failed_register: Could not register shortcut with the system (it may be in use by another app)
hotkeys.action_next_track_hint: Skip to the next song in the queue.
hotkeys.action_prev_track_hint: Return to the previous song in the queue.
hotkeys.action_mute_toggle_hint: Toggle between muted and previous volume.
hotkeys.action_seek_forward_hint: Jump forward 10 seconds in the track.
hotkeys.action_seek_backward_hint: Jump backward 10 seconds in the track.
hotkeys.action_toggle_shuffle_hint: Turn shuffle on or off for the queue.
hotkeys.action_toggle_repeat_hint: Cycle repeat mode: off, all, one.
hotkeys.action_show_app_hint: Bring the Limusic window to the foreground.

data.clear_cache_hint: Frees up disk space by clearing cached thumbnails and audio chunks.

about.description: A beautiful, fast, and lightweight desktop music player powered by Tauri and Svelte.
about.up_to_date: You are using the latest version.
about.update_packaged: This build was installed with a package manager, update it the same way.
about.rollback_available: This version is being rolled back to {version}, the last known-good release.
about.diagnostics_hint: Your version, this system and the last part of the app log, ready to paste into a bug report. Cookies, tokens, signed links, file paths and IP addresses are removed first.
about.diagnostics_save_hint: Same text as a .txt, for dragging into the issue instead of pasting it.
about.report_issue_hint: Opens GitHub in your browser, with the version and system filled in.
about.kofi_hint: Limusic is free and stays free. Ko-fi is there if you feel like chipping in.

discord.enable_hint: Show the currently playing song on your Discord profile.
discord.off_notice: Rich Presence is off, so this is not on your profile. The preview still follows your changes.
discord.show_paused_hint: Keep the card up while the track is paused. Discord has no paused state, so the progress bar is dropped rather than left running.
discord.hide_details_hint: Say only that music is playing. No title, artist, album, artwork, progress bar or buttons leave your machine.
discord.status_line_hint: What Discord shows next to your name in the member list. The profile card below always shows the app name.
discord.app_name_hint: Replaces "Limusic" wherever the app name appears. Leave empty to keep it.
discord.line1_hint: The bold line, right under the header.
discord.cover_hint: Show the artwork next to the track.
discord.badge_hint: Mark the artwork with a small Limusic icon, the way Spotify and Apple Music cards do.
discord.line3_hint: The last line. Discord also uses it as the artwork’s hover text, so it needs the album art on.
discord.timestamps_hint: Show elapsed and remaining time under the track.
discord.links_hint: Turn a part of the card into a link. Discord opens it in YouTube Music, and the target follows what that part shows: a line with the album opens the album.
discord.buttons_hint: Discord shows at most two, and never on your own profile: only other people see them. A button whose target this track has no link for is skipped.
discord.preview_paused: Paused, so this is not on your profile right now. Turn on "Show when paused" to keep it up.

listen_together.alone_hint: Nobody else yet. Share the code above to fill the room.
